STATUS: ANSWER
The whole-genome and chromosome Y QC files are intervals_wgs and intervals_y. They are Picard-style interval list files covering the entire genome or only chromosome Y, and they are mandatory for the QC stats step [rare_usage#h014]. A version for GRCh37 and GRCh38 is supplied in the pipeline assets, and they are not needed when using Sentieon [rare_usage#h014].
The provided sources do not describe how to pass extra arguments to a tool that the pipeline does not expose by default, so that part is not covered.
